narrative:
Morgan County has 8,758 registered voters, with 47.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 41.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 11.2%, a pronounced Republican lean of 30.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.8% of registrants.
